'''Lunddel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], he ran a small shop, where he built and sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weaponry.
